items.title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
items.summary: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.
items.creator: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: Ford Fathom will be the cheapest American EV capable of powering a house
items.summary: Ford is rolling out two new chargers capable of powering a home or the grid — so-called V2x capability.
items.creator: Tim De Chant

items.title: US government says hackers are now exploiting critical PHP web bugs
items.summary: The U.S. government cyber agency warns that hackers have figured out a way to exploit the popular PHP software, used in 70% of the web's software.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker

items.title: Apple unveils new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 chip
items.summary: The new MacBook Pro comes with 24 hours of battery life, and now features support for Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity.
items.creator: Aisha Malik
